title: Crate Pusher
author: cobanov
description: A cosy 3D warehouse puzzle: push every crate onto its spot in 30 original levels, from tiny tutorials to real brain-teasers, and try to match each level's par.

controls.D-pad: Walk and push (hold to keep going); choose a level
controls.A: Play the chosen level; next level
controls.B: Undo (hold to rewind); back to level select (paused or level clear)
